label: Every actual distinct esse is caused by another being in act, mode of causing unspecified
paraphrase: For every x that actually exists with esse distinct from its essence (DistinctEsseAt), some c other than x (c distinct from x only, not non-constituency) is in act as to being and causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION, the tenseless cause of being). The mode of causing is not specified: this is not the claim that the cause is efficient, and it is kept apart from STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE, whose paraphrase reads the cause as efficient. No conservation, present sustaining, world-indexed existence, concreteness or uniqueness is asserted.
